title: Ender Chest Just Ender Chest
description: A plugin that lets you collect Ender Chests without needing precise collection!
body:
# Ender Chest Just Ender Chest (ECJEC)
[中文请戳这](https://www.minebbs.com/resources/ecjec-ender-chest-just-ender-chest.16465/)

**"Just shut up, an ender chest is an ender chest!"**

---

## Introduction

**ECJEC** is a minimalist plugin for Minecraft 1.12.2 Spigot / Paper servers.  
It does just one thing: **allows ender chests to be mined without the Silk Touch enchantment** — breaking an ender chest drops the ender chest itself, not obsidian.

> "Just shut up, an ender chest is an ender chest!" — Author

---

## Features

- ✅ Breaking an ender chest with any tool (or even bare hands) drops an **ender chest** (instead of 8 obsidian)
- ✅ Fully compatible with Survival and Creative modes
- ✅ No configuration file, just drop and play
- ✅ Extremely small size, zero performance overhead

---

## Installation

1. Download `ECJEC.jar`
2. Put the file into your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Done! Now try breaking an ender chest

> Works on **Spigot 1.12.2** or **Paper 1.12.2** servers.

---

## Usage

**No commands or permissions required.**  
The plugin takes effect automatically after installation: whenever a player breaks an ender chest, the dropped item will always be an ender chest.

---

## Configuration

This plugin has **no configuration file**.  
If you want to toggle the feature on/off… just disable or delete the plugin (the author was too lazy to write a config).
